Resolves #20606

🌿 A release that ships on a weekend no longer waits until Monday to reach the Engine.

`.github/dependabot.yml` moves both ecosystems, npm and github-actions, from `interval: daily` (Monday to Friday) to `interval: cron` with `cronjob: "30 7 * * *"`, every day at the morning hour the job already used. A one-line header note says why. Majors, cooldown (`neo-agent-skills` excluded) and grouping are unchanged.

Micro-review eligible: config-leaf, a schedule value in two blocks.

Evidence: L1 (the file parses: both schedules read `{"interval":"cron","cronjob":"30 7 * * *"}`) → L2 required post-merge (a weekend Dependabot run). Residual: AC 2, the first weekend run.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `js-yaml` reads both `schedule` blocks as `{"interval":"cron","cronjob":"30 7 * * *"}`; the diff touches nothing else. |
| AC-2 | Post-merge: a dynamic `npm_and_yarn in /.` run appears on Saturday Nov 14 or Sunday Nov 15. |
